title: Victorian Guest Cottage with pool!
description:
Charming 4 bd 2 bath Victorian Guest cottage on Country estate directly between Nashville (20 min) and Historic Franklin (15 min). Downstairs has 1 King, 1 Queen. Upstairs also has 1 King and 1 queen. Downstairs there is living room with fireplace, kitchen, 2 baths,  and a laundry room. Please note both bathrooms are downstairs. Relax and enjoy a wrap around porch w/rockers overlooking the perennial garden. Guest have use of heated saltwater pool. 8 adults (max). Sorry, no bachelorette parties.

The space
Guests are welcome to use the pool all they want. There is a zipline in the back yard children may use if parents are present. Pool towels are provided but must be washed before leaving.
The kitchen has cooking essentials, a coffee pot and a Keurig with pods.

Guest access
Guests are welcome to wander the beautiful 4 acres including the vegetable garden and stone chapel. If children would like to hold or feed a chicken ( or collect some eggs) just let us know!
